integrity: Self-contained proof with a deterministic Python standard-library direct-enumeration checker; finite checks are not substitutes for the analytic proof. Independent validation has not been performed.
limitations: Two labeled conjugate statistical channels; equal prior, equal pooled weights, two independent observations, finite output alphabet. No sharp universal homogenization constant or extension to nonconjugate channels claimed.
title: Odd posterior moments exactly classify information-mixing reversal for conjugate binary-input channels
